title: OpenAirInterface CN5G AMF before 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in…
description: OpenAirInterface CN5G AMF versions prior to 2.2.2 have a vulnerability in the amf_sbi::handle_itti_message() function that causes stale PDU session contexts to persist when NRF lookup or SMF selection fails. Authenticated UEs can trigger this by requesting PDU sessions when no SMF is selectable, leading to deregistration delays and stalling NAS processing for other UEs. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or integrity but may cause availability degradation.
